description: The signed-in member's watchlists, the same lists Vela shows on the web and in the Vela apps: each list's id and name with every symbol in it, as the market it streams (source:TICKER), its category and section, and a Vela chart link (chart_url). Use it to answer what the member watches, and before watchlists_add_symbols or watchlists_remove_symbols to get a list's id. It carries no prices. An empty answer means the member has no watchlist yet (watchlists_create makes one). Requires signing in with a LuxAlgo account (OAuth).
